name: Cake Shop
author: Addicting Games
description: Cake Shop is a free resource management game. Bake cakes in this fun time-management game. You’re a chef in this cake shop and it’s your job to both make and serve cakes to customers. Each customer is different, so you’ll have to put together a different cake with filling each time. The faster you serve the cake, the better tip you’ll get. It also helps if you get the order right. If you get it wrong, you’ll have to trash because the customer won’t take it. With every shift, you’ll earnings will all be calculated together. You’ll be able to get equipment that can help you run your shop. For instance, you can work to get a coffee machine that will add another item to your sales. In this fun time-management baking game, you’ll start off slow but each level brings you more customers and more items to serve. You’ll eventually get a table to help you make items ahead and stay ahead of the crowd. As it gets more difficult, you’ll have to speed up but still remain accurate so you don’t have upset customers. The worst thing you can do is have a customer wait so long that they leave the shop. If you make a mistake you can throw your cake away in the trash. If you don’t make enough cash that day, you can replay the level.
